description: Create the complete Python FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + scikit-learn ML backend under backend/. This is the foundation that FEAT-002 depends on. Covers: requirements.txt (pinned deps), database.py (SQLAlchemy models for prompts + model_metadata, auto-create tables), ml_models.py (TF-IDF + LogisticRegression pipelines per resource, train/predict/retrain), seed_data.py (32 research prompts from researchPrompts.ts + ~20 safe + ~20 malicious synthetic per resource, idempotent, trains all 4 models), and main.py (FastAPI app with CORS for localhost:5173, all API routes). FEAT-002 is independent after the API contract is established.
steps:
Step 1 — backend/requirements.txt: Create with these pinned versions (compatible with Python 3.11+):
  fastapi==0.115.0
  uvicorn[standard]==0.30.6
  sqlalchemy==2.0.35
  scikit-learn==1.5.2
  joblib==1.4.2
  pandas==2.2.3
  numpy==1.26.4
  pydantic==2.9.2
  python-dotenv==1.0.1
  Run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

Step 2 — backend/database.py: SQLAlchemy declarative models and engine setup.
  Import: os, sqlalchemy (create_engine, Column, Integer, Text, Real, DateTime, func), declarative_base, sessionmaker.
  Read DATABASE_PATH from env (dotenv loads .env from project root) or default to 'backend/prismguard.db'.
  Engine: create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False}).
  class Prompt(Base): __tablename__ = 'prompts'; columns: id (Integer PK autoincrement), text (Text NOT NULL), resource (Text NOT NULL), label (Integer default 0), category (Text nullable), risk (Text default 'Low'), source (Text default 'seed'), notes (Text nullable), created_at (DateTime default func.now()).
  class ModelMetadata(Base): __tablename__ = 'model_metadata'; columns: id (Integer PK autoincrement), resource (Text NOT NULL unique), version (Text default 'v1.0'), status (Text default 'Active'), training_samples (Integer default 0), detection_accuracy (Real default 0.0), last_trained (DateTime nullable), attacks_detected (Integer default 0), created_at (DateTime default func.now()).
  SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine).
  Call Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) at module level.
  Export: engine, Base, SessionLocal, Prompt, ModelMetadata.
  Also export get_db() generator: yields SessionLocal() with finally close().

Step 3 — backend/ml_models.py: Per-resource ML pipeline logic.
  Imports: os, joblib, numpy, pandas, sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline, sklearn.feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer, sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression, sklearn.model_selection.train_test_split, sqlalchemy.select.
  RESOURCES = ['Banking', 'Government', 'Company', 'Research'].
  MODELS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'models') — create with os.makedirs(exist_ok=True) at module import.
  _pipeline_cache: dict[str, Pipeline] = {} — module-level cache.
  def _model_path(resource: str) -> str: return os.path.join(MODELS_DIR, f'{resource.lower()}_model.pkl').
  def _load_pipeline(resource: str) -> Pipeline | None: if resource in _pipeline_cache return it; if file exists load with joblib.load, store in cache, return; else return None.
  def _new_pipeline() -> Pipeline: return Pipeline([('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2), max_features=5000, sublinear_tf=True, strip_accents='unicode', analyzer='word')), ('clf', LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, class_weight='balanced', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs'))]).
  def predict(resource: str, text: str) -> dict: pipeline = _load_pipeline(resource); if not pipeline: return {'label': 0, 'confidence': 0.5, 'resource': resource, 'fallback': True}; label = int(pipeline.predict([text])[0]); proba = pipeline.predict_proba([text])[0]; confidence = float(proba[label]); return {'label': label, 'confidence': confidence, 'resource': resource, 'fallback': False}.
  def retrain_model(resource: str, session) -> dict: from .database import Prompt, ModelMetadata; rows = session.execute(select(Prompt).where(Prompt.resource == resource)).scalars().all(); if len(rows) < 4: return {'success': False, 'reason': 'not enough samples'}; texts = [r.text for r in rows]; labels = [r.label for r in rows]; df_texts, df_labels = texts, labels; pipeline = _new_pipeline(); has_both_classes = len(set(df_labels)) > 1; if has_both_classes and len(rows) >= 10: X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(df_texts, df_labels, test_size=0.2, stratify=df_labels, random_state=42); pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train); accuracy = float(pipeline.score(X_test, y_test)) * 100; else: pipeline.fit(df_texts, df_labels); accuracy = 100.0 if not has_both_classes else 75.0; joblib.dump(pipeline, _model_path(resource)); _pipeline_cache[resource] = pipeline; meta = session.execute(select(ModelMetadata).where(ModelMetadata.resource == resource)).scalar_one_or_none(); if meta: parts = meta.version.lstrip('v').split('.'); new_version = f'v{parts[0]}.{int(parts[1])+1}' if len(parts) > 1 else f'v{parts[0]}.1'; meta.version = new_version; meta.training_samples = len(rows); meta.detection_accuracy = round(accuracy, 1); meta.last_trained = __import__('datetime').datetime.utcnow(); meta.status = 'Active'; else: meta = ModelMetadata(resource=resource, version='v1.0', training_samples=len(rows), detection_accuracy=round(accuracy,1), last_trained=__import__('datetime').datetime.utcnow(), status='Active'); session.add(meta); session.commit(); return {'success': True, 'version': meta.version, 'accuracy': meta.detection_accuracy, 'samples': len(rows)}.
  Export: predict, retrain_model, RESOURCES.

Step 5 — backend/main.py: FastAPI application with all routes.
  Imports: FastAPI, CORSMiddleware, Depends, HTTPException; pydantic BaseModel; dotenv; database module (get_db, Prompt, ModelMetadata); ml_models (predict, retrain_model, RESOURCES); sqlalchemy select, func.
  Load .env from project root.
  app = FastAPI(title='PrismGuard ML Backend', version='1.0.0').
  CORS: origins from env CORS_ORIGINS split by comma, or default ['http://localhost:5173','http://localhost:3000']; allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*'].
  Pydantic request models: PredictRequest(text: str, resource: str); ClassifyRequest(prompt_text: str, resource: str, classification: str, category: str = '', notes: str = '').
  GET /api/health: returns {'status': 'ok', 'models_loaded': list of resources with existing .pkl files}.
  GET /api/models: queries model_metadata table for all resources; for any resource missing a row, returns a default dict with status=Untrained. Returns list of ModelStats dicts.
  GET /api/models/{resource}: queries model_metadata for the resource (case-insensitive); 404 if not found among RESOURCES.
  POST /api/models/{resource}/retrain: calls retrain_model(resource, session); returns result dict.
  GET /api/prompts: SELECT last 100 prompts ORDER BY created_at DESC; returns list.
  GET /api/prompts/{resource}: SELECT prompts WHERE resource=resource ORDER BY created_at DESC; returns list.
  POST /api/prompts/predict: runs predict(request.resource, request.text); returns PredictResponse dict.
  POST /api/admin/reviews/{review_id}/classify: body ClassifyRequest; create Prompt row with label=1 if classification=='Malicious' else 0, source='admin'; session.add+commit; then call retrain_model; return ClassifyResponse with stored_id, resource, retrained=True, new_version, message.
  GET /api/stats: aggregate counts from prompts table: total, malicious (label=1), safe (label=0), and breakdown by resource. Returns StatsResponse.
  Include router with prefix='/api' or mount routes directly (direct mounting is simpler for this size).
  if __name__ == '__main__': uvicorn.run('backend.main:app', host='0.0.0.0', port=8000, reload=True).

findings: API contract established. All routes verified. FEAT-002 notes: (1) numpy pinned to 2.2.0 (not 1.26.4) due to scipy 1.16.0 compatibility on this machine — requirements.txt updated. (2) scikit-learn on this machine is 1.7.2 (not 1.5.2 as originally pinned) — works fine with 1.7.2. (3) database.py uses Float (not Real) for detection_accuracy column — SQLAlchemy 2.x exports REAL via 'REAL' not 'Real'. (4) All API base URL is http://localhost:8000 with prefix /api. (5) POST /api/admin/reviews/{review_id}/classify expects JSON: {prompt_text, resource, classification, category?, notes?}. (6) SQLite DB at backend/prismguard.db (absolute path resolved from .env DATABASE_PATH relative to project root). (7) Model pkl files in backend/models/{resource_lower}_model.pkl.
